accepted_plan.summary: Implement protocol/pod/TUI support for connect-time snapshot of in-flight assistant text, thinking, and tool-call args so late attach/reconnect displays unfinished blocks and continues live deltas without gaps or duplicates.
accepted_plan.role_plan: Orchestrator creates a dedicated child worktree and spawns a narrow-scope Coder. Reviewer will be spawned read-only after Coder reports implementation commit(s). After approval, Orchestrator integrates into `orchestration`, validates protocol/pod/TUI tests, records closure, and cleans only the child worktree/branch.
